given.note: Sam signs in on the owner portal: the code goes to his email on file, lives 10 minutes, and never comes back to the caller (RULES 6.2). A sign-in acts for no person until its code is right, so caller.personId is null (K-22 v1 rule 4); whom the code is for is the account his typed email finds on the runtime side (forPersonId person-sam: a sign_in code, K-22 v1 proof_codes.person_id), never anything the browser sends.
